basic_info.description: This spacious top floor condo offers space, comfort, and timeless style in the heart of the Central Richmond District. Set in a gorgeous two-unit boutique building, this generously sized condominium consists of 2 bedrooms + sunroom and 1.5 baths with a layout that flows seamlessly from room to room. Large bay windows and newly refinished hardwood floors create a warm inviting space with a living room that flows to the dining room and into the updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops and great storage. For your convenience, the condo offers in-unit laundry, 1 car parking, a sizable storage area, and a large shared yard. Just steps from your door are some of the best restaurants, cafes and shops on the Clement Street corridor including Lokma, Tia Margarita, Big Fish House, Fiorella and Home Coffee Roasters. The whole building is also for sale (263-265 19th Ave). Don't miss out on your chance at this wonderful opportunity!
